title: Target Range Pro
description: Steady your sights across shifting bullseyes and swinging targets—nail crisp 10-ring streaks before ammo runs dry.
controls: Aim the reticle over moving bullseye targets and tap to fire clean center shots.

zh-CN.title: 神枪手打靶射击
zh-CN.description: 清爽减压横版打靶射击：瞄准移动标靶稳准扣动扳机，枪枪十环红心触发爆分连击！
zh-CN.controls: 移动准星锁定标靶红心点击射击，连续命中靶心刷新神枪手高分纪录。
